evidence_constraint_rows.evidence_finding: The annual Schedule SE instructions require taxpayer-year aggregation and cross-business farm/nonfarm loss offsets before the threshold test.
evidence_constraint_rows.required_resolution: The official inventory and SE aggregation registry must prove that every eligible component collapses to one taxpayer-year unit; per-group flooring or thresholding is unsupported.

evidence_constraint_rows.evidence_finding: Every 1968-1989 annual return permits a conditional farm optional method, and 1973-1989 returns also permit a conditional nonfarm optional method.
evidence_constraint_rows.required_resolution: Complete transforms require official-inventory gross farm/nonfarm income, election, prior-year SE, and lifetime-use facts.

evidence_constraint_rows.evidence_finding: Staged P.L. 98-369 section 2603(c)-(e), 98 Stat. 1128-1130, establishes a 1984-1989 electing-church path under which the ordinary $400 rule does not apply and remuneration below $100 is excluded.
evidence_constraint_rows.required_resolution: The official inventory must supply church election, remuneration, and HI-only/OASDI wage-coordination facts; a blanket $400 transform is incomplete.
